tools.name: project_clicks_at_ctr
tools.description: Calculates the clicks a number of impressions would earn at a CTR you choose (impressions × CTR). Use it for a what-if on one period; compare_ctr_periods is for two observed periods and impressions_needed_for_clicks for the opposite direction. The result is a modelled value and may be fractional.

tools.name: impressions_needed_for_clicks
tools.description: Calculates how many impressions a click target needs at a CTR you choose (clicks ÷ CTR). Use it to size a goal; project_clicks_at_ctr goes the other way. The result is a modelled value. With a CTR of 0 there is no answer, and the result gives the reason instead of a number.

tools.name: check_gsc_reporting_issues
tools.description: Lists the known Google Search Console reporting issues, taken from Google's own notices, that overlap the dates you give, with the affected metrics, the sources they apply to and the source link. findings.detail: Description of "compare_ctr_periods" stacks urgency/override words (always, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
